# Appearance studio evidence

These captures come from mounted production editor/card owners, real SDK requests and real Hono appearance routes/storage in Chromium. The surrounding shell, signed-in principal, host lease and preview catalog are controlled fixtures. They do not establish a full App conversation, real provider, installed shell or deployed Nightly journey.

Before: Appearance studio disabled, original manual palette/CSS editor. After: studio enabled, uploaded bundled background, library, and exact-source inline proposal card. The browser test exercises a trusted pointer Keep, repeated saved-theme edits, image upload, export and reimport as an unapplied draft.

See `receipt.json` for the source/test fingerprints, widths, themes, assertions and limits. Images are for visual review; separate focused tests cover stale/relay/permission/feature/size boundaries and injected failures.
